integrity: A self-contained C++17 exhaustive enumerator and the canonical 47-representative table are included; finite and scalar-extension checks are explained in the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only commutative bilinear laws on a three-dimensional vector space over the two-element field are classified.
Pointwise Jordan identities are distinguished explicitly from identities stable under scalar extension.
No statement is made about quadratic Jordan structures or dimensions greater than three.
Literature coverage is bounded, and independent specialist audit has not been performed.
title: The binary boundary of three-dimensional Jordan multiplication laws
